title: iPhone Driving Mode: Never Text & Drive Again!
description:
In this short video, Sgt. Rick Verbeck shows iPhone users how to activate Driving Focus Mode, a simple feature that automatically replies to texts when you are behind the wheel. When connected to CarPlay or your vehicle’s Bluetooth, your phone can let others know you are driving and will respond when it is safe to do so.

The goal is simple: reduce distractions, make safer choices, and protect yourself and everyone else on the road.

Watch as “Future Rick” walks you through the steps on screen, then enjoy a lighthearted reminder for Android users at the end.

No text is worth a life. Make the pact. Drive focused.

#TrafficSafety #DistractedDriving #DriveSafe #SMPD #FocusMode #YouTubeShorts
